description_en: Queries the list of notification recipients for a project
description_zh: 查询项目通知接收者列表
name: ListProjectNotifyReceivers

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host. 
You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。 
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The project ID.
You can call ListProjects to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
项目ID。
您可以调用 ListProjects 获取该参数
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的条数。不填时默认查询 20 条。最多查询100条
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The request token. Leave this parameter empty or set it to an empty string for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 请求 Token，首次请求不传或者传空字符串
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name, phone number, or email address of the notification recipient to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的消息通知接收人名称/手机号/邮箱。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to skip.
This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty
parameters.help_zh:
跳过数量。
仅在 NextToken 取值为空时生效
parameters.name: skip

Email.description_en: The email address of the recipient

Phone.description_en: The phone number of the recipient

ReceiverId.description_en: The ID of the notification recipient

MaxResults.description_en: The value of the MaxResults request parameter passed in the request if a valid parameter value was specified. Otherwise, the default value is returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 请求参数中传了有效MaxResults时返回请求时所传的值，否则返回默认值

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next request. Use this value for the NextToken request parameter in the next paged query. If this field is empty in the response, no more data is available. This parameter is used for paging
NextToken.description_zh: 下次请求Token，用于分页查询时下一次查询填写到请求参数NextToken中。若响应中该字段为空时，表示无更多数据

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of recipients returned
